convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call the VortexIndicator_Duplex custom indicator, which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The Vortex Indicator is a custom indicator requiring separate compilation and availability in the Indicators directory.

other_exits: Opposite vortex signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative lot values = fixed lots; Positive lot values = fraction of deposit (margin-based)

custom_logic_notes: The Vortex Indicator calculates VM+ and VM- lines. When VM+ crosses above VM-, a long position is opened (and any existing short is closed). When VM+ crosses below VM-, a short position is opened (and any existing long is closed). The EA uses previous completed bar values (shift=1) for signal detection to avoid repainting. Position sizing has dual mode: negative Lots input = fixed lot size, positive Lots input = deposit fraction. SL and TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers (multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
external_dependencies: VortexIndicator_Duplex.ex5 (custom indicator required in Indicators folder)
python_conversion_notes: The Vortex Indicator must be reimplemented in Python. The Vortex calculation is: VM+ = |High[0] - Low[1]|, VM- = |Low[0] - High[1]|, smoothed by a WMA or SMA of the chosen period. VI+ = VM+ / ATR(period), VI- = VM- / ATR(period). Crossover of VI+ above VI- triggers long; crossover below triggers short. The custom indicator source must be obtained to confirm the exact smoothing method and ATR calculation used. The digit adjustment logic for SL/TP (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated in Python. The conditional position sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) must be implemented with proper margin calculation.
